label: TAP
type: an internal protocol that streamed data-change information between cluster nodes, predating DCP. Removed from Couchbase Server in version 5.0. Not to be confused with the unrelated Linux TAP network-interface concept.
evidence: TAP is an internal protocol that streams information about data changes between cluster nodes. It was replaced by DCP and removed from Couchbase Server in version 5.0.
note: SIGNIFICANCE EXCEPTION at recurrence 1, promoted as a pair with relations/removed-in.json: this record exists specifically to be the object of the removedIn relation, and removedIn cannot be filed without a concept to point it at. cbstats tap-vbtakeover is a legacy-compatibility command (retainedForLegacyCompatibility, reused) that reads stats from clusters still running TAP; protocol:dcp supersedes protocol:tap (supersedes, reused - a clean cross-round confirmation of round 28's mint).
